meta.name: DJPPR Communication Deck — Typography Tokens
meta.source: Strategi Komunikasi DJPPR Semester II (29 Juni 2021)
meta.extractionMethod: Read directly from the PDF's embedded font table (pdffonts) — this is exact, not visually estimated.
meta.confidenceNote: Font family names are high-confidence (from embedded font subsets). Sizes/weights below are visually estimated from slide layout and should be treated as a starting point, not measured values.

display.usage: All headlines, slide titles, card/badge labels, stat numbers. This is the deck's primary and most distinctive typeface — a condensed geometric sans.
display.webFallback: Oswald, Barlow Condensed, or Bebas Neue (condensed geometric sans) if Gotham Narrow is unlicensed for web use.

body.usage: Body copy, bullet lists, table content on several content slides.

bodyAlt.usage: Body copy / table content on a subset of slides (likely default PowerPoint theme font carried over from source content).

iconography.usage: A handful of inline glyph bullets — not meaningful outside PowerPoint; replace with a proper icon set (e.g. the outline-style icons already used elsewhere in the deck) rather than porting this font.

scale.note: Estimated from slide proportions (1334x750 reference canvas), not measured. Treat as a reasonable starting ratio.

body.color: core.textDark or core.textOnDark depending on background
